# Billing and invoices

## Payment methods

Accepted methods: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and ACH for Enterprise accounts.
Cryptocurrency is not accepted.

## Invoice timing

Invoices are generated on the first calendar day of each month for monthly plans,
and on the anniversary date for annual plans.

Failed payments retry automatically after **3 days** and again after **7 days**.
After the second failed retry, service is suspended until payment succeeds.

## Late fees

A late fee of **$25** applies when an invoice remains unpaid 15 days past due.
Enterprise accounts may negotiate late-fee waivers in writing.
